WHERE ABS(rc."behav_score" - LEAST(100, rc."behav_score" + (0.3 * (REGEXP_REPLACE(ms.manip_signals->>'spoof_prob', '%', '')::numeric / 100) + 0.2 * (CASE WHEN ms.layer_idx = 'Confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 0.1 * ms.stuff_idx))) > 0.001;

FROM reg_compliance rc

JOIN order_behaviour ob ON ob."REC_NODE" = mc."REC_PIN"
JOIN trade_records tr ON tr."tr_anchor" IN (SELECT "TR_KEY" FROM traders WHERE CAST(trader_fin_data->>'age_days' AS integer) >= 2400);
